---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  run: null
  title: "nanoflow run report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
run <- params$run
samples <- run$samples[setdiff(names(run$samples), "_run")]
step_or_null <- function(steps, name) {
  s <- steps[[name]]
  if (inherits(s, "nanoflow_step")) s else NULL
}
read_if <- function(path, reader, ...) {
  if (!is.null(path) && length(path) == 1 && file.exists(path)) {
    tryCatch(reader(path, ...), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
}
```

# Run overview

Output directory: `` `r run$output_dir` `` — finished `r run$finished`.

```{r overview}
rows <- lapply(names(samples), function(id) {
  steps <- samples[[id]]
  marks <- vapply(steps, function(s) {
    if (!inherits(s, "nanoflow_step")) return("—")
    switch(s$status, ok = "✓", skipped = "↷ (resumed)", "✗ failed")
  }, "")
  data.frame(sample = id, step = names(steps), status = marks,
             tool = vapply(steps, function(s)
               paste(s$tool %||% "", s$tool_version %||% ""), ""),
             runtime_s = vapply(steps, function(s)
               round(s$runtime_sec %||% NA_real_, 1), 0),
             row.names = NULL)
})
if (length(rows)) knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, rows))
```

```{r multiqc, results="asis"}
mq <- run$samples[["_run"]]$multiqc
if (inherits(mq, "nanoflow_step") && mq$status == "ok") {
  cat(sprintf("The aggregated **[MultiQC report](%s)** collects all tool-level QC.\n",
              mq$outputs$html))
}
```

# Read QC

```{r nanostats, results="asis"}
for (id in names(samples)) {
  for (which in c("qc_nanoplot", "qc_nanoplot_filtered")) {
    st <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], which)
    stats <- read_if(st$outputs$stats, readLines)
    if (is.null(stats)) next
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s — %s\n\n```\n%s\n```\n", id,
                if (which == "qc_nanoplot") "raw reads" else "after Porechop + Filtlong",
                paste(stats, collapse = "\n")))
  }
}
```

# Alignment

```{r align, results="asis"}
for (id in names(samples)) {
  st <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "align")
  if (is.null(st)) next
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n- BAM: `%s`\n", id, st$outputs$bam %||% "—"))
  qm <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "bam_qc")
  if (!is.null(qm) && qm$status == "ok") {
    cat(sprintf("- [Qualimap report](%s)\n", qm$outputs$report))
  }
}
```

# Assembly

```{r assembly, results="asis"}
any_asm <- FALSE
for (id in names(samples)) {
  st <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "assembly_qc")
  tsv <- read_if(st$outputs$report_tsv, utils::read.delim, check.names = FALSE)
  if (is.null(tsv)) next
  any_asm <- TRUE
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s (QUAST)\n\n", id))
  print(knitr::kable(tsv))
}
if (!any_asm) cat("*Assembly branch not run.*\n")
```

# Phasing

```{r phasing, results="asis"}
for (id in names(samples)) {
  st <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "phase")
  stats <- read_if(st$outputs$stats_tsv, utils::read.delim)
  if (!is.null(stats)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s — WhatsHap statistics\n\n", id))
    keep <- intersect(c("chromosome", "variants", "phased", "unphased",
                        "blocks", "block_n50"), names(stats))
    print(knitr::kable(stats[, keep, drop = FALSE]))
  }
  cmp <- read_if(st$outputs$compare_tsv, utils::read.delim)
  if (!is.null(cmp)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s — switch errors vs truth (whatshap compare)\n\n", id))
    keep <- intersect(c("chromosome", "all_switches", "all_switch_rate",
                        "blockwise_hamming_rate"), names(cmp))
    print(knitr::kable(cmp[, keep, drop = FALSE]))
  }
}
```

# Benchmarks against truth

```{r benchmarks, results="asis"}
any_bench <- FALSE
for (id in names(samples)) {
  hp <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "benchmark_small")
  if (!is.null(hp$params$metrics)) {
    any_bench <- TRUE
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s — small variants (hap.py)\n\n", id))
    print(knitr::kable(hp$params$metrics, digits = 4))
  }
  tv <- step_or_null(samples[[id]], "benchmark_sv")
  if (!is.null(tv$params$metrics)) {
    any_bench <- TRUE
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s — structural variants (Truvari)\n\n", id))
    print(knitr::kable(tv$params$metrics, digits = 4))
  }
}
if (!any_bench) cat("*No truth VCFs in the sample sheet; benchmarking skipped.*\n")
```

# Provenance

Every command, tool version and runtime is in
`` `r file.path(run$output_dir, "provenance.json")` ``.

```{r provenance}
rows <- lapply(names(samples), function(id) {
  steps <- samples[[id]]
  data.frame(
    sample = id,
    step = names(steps),
    command = vapply(steps, function(s)
      paste(utils::head(s$command, 1) %||% "", collapse = " "), ""),
    row.names = NULL)
})
if (length(rows)) {
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  df$command <- substr(df$command, 1, 160)
  knitr::kable(df)
}
```
